components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: The selected Sourcey page, identified with both a surface and text colour.
components.html: OrnaDBGetting started
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-navigation__link { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--colour-ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-navigation__link--active { background: var(--colour-surface-active); color: var(--colour-brand-deep); font-weight: 600; } .ds-navigation__link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--colour-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Inline Code
components.description: Short identifiers and syntax inside prose without decorative backticks.
components.html: Run a CREATE SERVER FUNCTION beside the data.
components.css: .ds-inline-code { padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid var(--colour-line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--colour-surface); color: var(--colour-brand-deep); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.875em; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Source Window
components.description: The primary visual material for source and invocation commands.
components.css: .ds-source-window { position: relative; overflow: hidden; margin: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--colour-code); color: var(--colour-code-ink); } .ds-source-window button { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--colour-code-ink); } .ds-source-window pre { overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; padding: 20px; font: 400 14px/1.7 var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Development Status Callout
components.description: An explicit warning that examples may describe intended language rather than released features.
components.html:
DEVELOPMENT STATUS

Examples show the intended language unless a page says that a feature is implemented.
components.css: .ds-status { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.73 0.11 88); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: oklch(0.96 0.045 95); color: var(--colour-ink); } .ds-status strong { color: oklch(0.48 0.14 75); font: 600 12px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-status p { margin: 8px 0 0; }

narrative.overview:
The documentation is the website. There is no separate campaign-style frontpage, product pitch, or visual hand-off before readers reach technical material. Sourcey supplies the stable documentation shell at /; the overview page introduces the model with real syntax and links directly into the guide.

The interface should resemble a maintained open-source systems project: quiet, exact, searchable, and close to source. Navigation, status, code, and cross-references carry the experience.
keyCharacteristics: one documentation interface at every route
technical content and status before promotional claims
persistent navigation, full-text search, and on-page headings
code as the primary visual material
a restrained moss identity on a white reading surface
responsive navigation and complete keyboard access

rules.name: The Status Is Text Rule
rules.body: Every status colour has a written label such as IMPLEMENTED, LOCKED, CURRENT PROPOSAL, or OPEN.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Moss identifies selection and structure. It does not become a decorative page-sized field.

rules.name: The Source Has Priority Rule
rules.body: Fenced source remains large enough to read, uses high-contrast dark syntax colours, and scrolls horizontally rather than clipping or wrapping semantics.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Depth indicates structure or interaction, never decoration.

dos: Do put valid Orna syntax and an honest development-status notice on the overview.
Do send readers directly to language, invocation, architecture, security, examples, and status pages.
Do preserve Sourcey's search, navigation, responsive layout, and generated discovery files.
Do distinguish implemented work, locked design, current proposals, open questions, and future work in text.
Do keep internal links rooted at their final public routes.
donts: Don't add a separate marketing frontpage before the documentation.
Don't build conversion funnels, testimonial strips, pricing cards, or inflated claims.
Don't replace technical material with gradients, abstract graphics, or decorative terminals.
Don't present a current proposal or roadmap item as a released feature.
Don't use ambient shadows, glass effects, large radii, or decorative grids.
Don't fork or recreate Sourcey's navigation and documentation behaviours in custom Astro components.
